notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal damage to Mogg Maniac.
description:
Deal damage to Mogg Maniac.
Mogg Maniac and Fiendlash trigger.
Resolve the Mogg Maniac trigger, dealing damage to an applicable target.
Resolve the Fiendlash trigger, targeting you, but dealing damage to Mogg Maniac instead due to Pariah's Shield.
Repeat from step 2.
